scorer.status: access blocked by provider regional HTTP 451 before scoring

answerer.status: not run; exact runtime/weights identity must be recorded before answer evaluation

metrics_policy.evidence_recall: Macro mean of the fraction of required evidence retrieved, over observed evidence-bearing cases. Also report micro counts and coverage.
metrics_policy.complete_evidence: Fraction of observed evidence-bearing cases with every required evidence record. Unanswerable cases are excluded from these denominators.
metrics_policy.unanswerable: Report empty-context diagnostics separately; they are not final-answer correctness.
metrics_policy.scope_and_staleness: Verify exact original references and case scope; current output must exclude historical/inactive/future originals.
metrics_policy.answer_accuracy: Requires separate unchanged-4B supported-answer and citation evaluation; retrieval scores do not establish correctness.
metrics_policy.partial_results: Keep observed incomplete contexts but flag them and missing arms. Never treat unexecuted cases/arms as successful.

limitations: Synthetic 20-question initial screen, not a population estimate or MCU/production qualification.
Canary/tuning fixtures use different entities; no model has scored these held-out cases.
Do not edit the frozen corpus/labels/policy after observing results; record a separate version for a justified future study.
